```{r fig.width=10,fig.height=4.5,dpi=300}
library(maptools)
library(raster)
library(ggmap)

world <- map_data("world")

dbg_sites <- c("fresno, california","puerto rico","singapore")
wmp_sites <- c("cairns, australia","vinh luong, vietnam",
               "medellin","rio de janeiro","la paz, mexico","tahiti",
               "fiji","kiribati","new caledonia","yogyakarta")
sitetable <- data.frame("site"=c(dbg_sites,wmp_sites),
           "operator"=c(rep("debug",length(dbg_sites)),rep("WMP",length(wmp_sites))))

countryfile <- "country_geocoords.txt"
if(file.exists(countryfile)){
  locations <- read.table(countryfile,header=T) 
} else {
  register_google(key="AIzaSyBFbT5X6MjrepPAlzIj3zz1HS58hnIPtEM", write=T)
  sites <- unique(sitetable$site)
  locations <- geocode(sites)
  locations$sites <- sites
  locations$operator <- sitetable$operator
  write.table(locations,countryfile,sep="\t",row.names=F,col.names=T)
}



#countrytotals <- aggregate(num_bams ~ country,poptotals,FUN=sum)
#countrytotals <- merge(countrytotals,locations,all.x=T) %>% dplyr::rename(n=num_bams)


map <- ggplot() +
    geom_polygon(data = world, aes(x=long, y = lat, group=group), fill='grey',color="black",linewidth=0.2) +
    geom_point(data=locations, aes(x=lon, y=lat, fill=operator), size=5,shape=21,inherit.aes=F) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("dark blue","cyan")) +
    coord_fixed(ylim=c(-48,48),xlim=c(-155,140))+
    theme(axis.text=element_blank(),
          panel.border=element_rect(fill=NA, color="black"),
          #panel.background=element_rect(fill='light blue', color=NA),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          axis.title=element_blank(),
          legend.position="bottom")

print(map)
ggsave("wmp_dbg_release_locations.png",map,width=8,height=4.5,dpi=400)
```
